{{Quote|Following the death of their Jedi watchman, the Mid Rim world of Cadinth is wavering in its loyalty to the Republic.|Reporting on the event in the HoloNet News|<ref name="Article" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was chafing with a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|militant secessionist faction]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Cadinth]] took the Republic's side. At that time, this pro-Separatist '''uprising''' took place in Cadinth's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Saskapeg]], culminating in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the planet's [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Jedi Watchman]], [[Bodis-Ker Vitan]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] death prompted Cadinth's government, the [[Cadinth Oligarchy]], to withdraw its support of the Republic, with [[Prime Oligarch]] [[Rankwin Fopow]] rescinding prior decrees and declaring that Cadinth was "firmly undecided" between the two groups. The [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] reported on the events.<ref name="Article" />

==Behind the scenes==
The uprising was mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 55|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #55'']], a<ref name="Article" /> [[May 9]], [[2002]]<ref name="HNN55 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6774521|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-05-09|time=4:55 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> issue of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]]. The [[in-universe]] article that references it, entitled "Cadinth Loyalty Uncertain After Jedi Death,"<ref name="Article" /> was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
